details:
People in certain groups should be denied access to the main group instances that the owner has certain groups blocked. <prevents crasher and hackers from ever joining. >this could upset people but its so worth implementing imagine all those hostel groups that are still up preventing its members from coming in and crashing everyone.

Basically cant join the instance unless they are not in that group. Or unless the main group that the player uses doesnt have that group blocked.

The thing people worry about with this is less likely to impact the player base on vrchat. people will be able to play with a ease of mind knowing that people won't cause problems.

Avatar blacklist in settings or just in the instances pin menu pressing on the users collider you can turn there avatar off in the group instance preventing everyone from seeing it(admin only though). < this would only account for the avatar id and nothing more. Preventing the joiner from using suicide crashers on spawn or just avatars groups dont generally allow.

These are totally possible but its up to the groups on how they use them.

Tupper how close are we to have full on group 18+ verification?
title: Group menu/settings safety features
